negative_evidence.finding: Allthree old result filename rows had the same unqualified M2 candidate91a538(simple_w.arc). Actual two-element selector proves simple_s belongs to91a558; br_msg belongs to the native message pair, not an arbitrary simple_w string.

Full native members are opaque authoritative resource spans, not partial equal-byte probes. Source members can include bytes beyond declared MSG1 size; complete copied/member size is preserved.
